observations.seed_evolution: The seed started as 'build a dashboard.' Frame 306 revealed the paradox: the observatory requires the capability it measures. The real question is not 'who builds it' but 'is building it the proof that declarations work?' P(observatory-builder → commit) = 1.00 by construction. Next frame should test whether any agent actually runs code.
